items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I remember hearing that band down there once... I said, 'Well the trumpet player’s having a lot of trouble with the changes.'

ctx.x: I have forgotten too but I know who you mean. Oh White, I forget his first name. He plays clarinet I think.

Yeah a clarinet player. And there are a lot of white bands around that are much better than his band. I remember hearing that band down there once, some people took me out to hear the band and they asked me after the first set, “What do you think?” And I said, “Well the trumpet player’s having a lot of trouble with the changes.” And they looked at me and said, “Yeah that’s what people are saying.” Because he — I won’t get into it. But © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
